connector.name: Standup from your activity
connector.registryDescription: Generate your daily standup from real GitHub, Jira, Linear, and Slack activity.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package standup-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sathvic-kollu account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: GitHub read-only personal access token. Enables commits, PRs, and reviews. Leave all sources unset to use the built-in demo data.

env.name: JIRA_BASE_URL
env.description: Your Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://your-company.atlassian.net.

env.name: JIRA_EMAIL
env.description: Atlassian account email the API token belongs to.

env.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
env.description: Jira API token from id.atlassian.com. Read-only use.

env.name: LINEAR_API_KEY
env.description: Linear personal API key (read-only). Enables issue state changes and comments.

env.name: SLACK_TOKEN
env.description: Slack token with read scopes. Enables scanning your own messages for blocker language.

env.name: SLACK_CHANNELS
env.description: Optional comma-separated channel ids to scan when message search is unavailable.

env.name: STANDUP_NAME
env.description: Optional display name for the standup's owner.

env.name: STANDUP_DEMO_MODE
env.description: Set to true to force the demo dataset even when credentials are present.
